verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: Turnover: Bidder must have achieved minimum annual financial turnover (at current price level) from contract receipt of works (in all classes of civil engineering construction works or O&M services only) of Rs. 4 Crores in any three financial years out of last Five (5) financial years i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
verified_clauses.summary: Minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 4 Crores in any three financial years out of the last five financial years (Scenario 1).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: The details pertaining to Turnover for the year 2021-2022 to 2025-2026 shall be certified by Chartered Accountant on his own letter head and duly attested.
verified_clauses.summary: Turnover for 2021-2022 to 2025-2026 must be certified by a Chartered Accountant on letterhead.

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: If applicable penalties for each month exceed 25% of billing amount per month, for a block of 4 consecutive months, then contract shall be liable for termination.
verified_clauses.summary: Contract termination if monthly penalties exceed 25% of the billing amount for 4 consecutive months.
discrepancy_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (SLA penalty threshold, not an upfront qualification gate).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: Cumulative penalties levied against non-performance in any of the SLA (viz. operational, preventive or curative maintenance) exceeds 10% of the total contract value.
verified_clauses.summary: Contract termination if cumulative penalties exceed 10% of the total contract value.
discrepancy_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (SLA penalty threshold, not an upfront qualification gate).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: This insurance shall be for a limit of per occurrence of not less than the amount of Rs. 5 Lacs, with no limit on the number of occurrences.
verified_clauses.summary: Minimum insurance limit per occurrence shall be Rs. 5 Lacs with no limit on occurrences.
discrepancy_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (post-award insurance obligation).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: The depreciated value is considered Rs.3435.53 lac for the purpose of insurance for respective year.
verified_clauses.summary: Depreciated value considered is Rs. 3435.53 lac for insurance purposes.
discrepancy_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (post-award insurance obligation).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: pay the total amount of Security Deposit equal to 10 (ten) percent of the estimated cost or contract value (Part A & B of price bid) whichever is higher for the work put to tender.
verified_clauses.summary: Security Deposit shall be equal to 10% of the estimated cost or contract value (Part A & B of price bid) whichever is higher.
discrepancy_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (Performance security deposit).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: 5% (five) of the lumpsum fees shall be held back from each payment, as Retention money as per Clause 1 of General Conditions of Contract.
verified_clauses.summary: 5% of the lump sum fees is held back from each payment as retention money.
discrepancy_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (statutory cess and billing retention deductions).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: As per Building and other construction works welfare cess act and the provision under Rule No.5 of the rules of 1998 of Gujarat State, the 1% cess shall be recovered from the running account bill of the contractor.
verified_clauses.summary: A 1% labour cess is recovered from the contractor's running account bill.
discrepancy_notes: Originally classified as FINANCIAL; reclassified to CONTRACT_TERMS (statutory cess and billing retention deductions).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: Any bidder with “A” class& aboveof registration or higher in R&B/WRD of Govt. of Gujarat. However, the bidder will have to Post Qualify as per Financial & Technical Criteria given in the bid document.
verified_clauses.summary: Contractor must have 'A' class or higher registration in R&B/WRD of Govt. of Gujarat.

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: The experience certificate from the client equivalent to not below the rank of Executive Engineer shall be considered.
verified_clauses.summary: Experience certificates must be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer.

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: List of O & M works of similar nature already completed by the bidder during last 5 financial years i.e. From 2021-22 to 2025-26& up to one month prior to last date of submission of the bid
verified_clauses.summary: Bidder must submit a list of O&M works of similar nature completed during the last 5 financial years from 2021-22 to 2025-26 up to one month prior to bid submission deadline.

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: The board intends to hire contractor for comprehensive O&M through e-tendering system for a duration of 60 (sixty) months for the Radhanpur&SantalpurRWSSschemecovering 1 City/126 villages/ 11 Hamlets and 6Nos Village Tube WellsSpread across Taluka: Radhanpur and SantalpurDistrict: Patan based on NMC at RankpurHW.

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: Provide utility vehicle for pipeline inspection and repair activities by agency. Quantity as per Annexure III. This utility vehicle shall be a 4-seater pickup truck (utility vehicle) (mandatory).

verified_clauses.verbatim_quote: Rs. 18000/- (Rupees Eighteen Thousand Only)

verified_clauses.summary: Must have valid registration as 'A' Class & above Civil or Electrical Contractor in R&B / Water Resources Department, Govt of Gujarat.
